assign.outcome:
**One selection per PAGE — the ring, the rail and the hover now agree everywhere.** Five causes measured before anything changed, on the owner's own page: `land()` cleared rings inside the TARGET's workspace only; `paint.js`'s `views` holds ONE entry per item, so a drill onto a group painted a HIDDEN viewport box while the visible one showed nothing; `selection()` bound its Escape listener once per BOX (7 boxes, 7 handlers, the first stepping out and the rest returning early with their rings still on); nothing was page-wide (3 rings across 2 roots); and `land()`'s early return let `ext/layout` own the shared rail under our ring. End state before the fix: rail *"nothing selected"*, two permanent rings, further Escapes doing nothing — the owner's report exactly.

**The invariant, in one file.** `focus.js` is the only writer of `.panel.focus`: clear every ring on the **document**, then paint **every live view** of the selected panel (`pair(root)` walks the tree and each box together — the same walk `view()` made — so no ids are needed). Roots release each other with **no registry**, each letting go on a `panel-focus` whose `detail.root()` is not itself. Deleted, not guarded: the `$target` argument and its null check, the per-workspace clear, the `paint.js` import, the unchanged-id early return.

**Clicking off deselects** — anything that is not a workspace and not a surface that acts on the selection (rail, workspace bar, flow strip, dev rail, top layer). ⚠ CAPTURE phase: `draw_bar()` detaches the clicked button, and `closest()` on a detached node reads as "outside" — every playground viewport switch was silently dropping the selection until this moved.

**Hover = what a click selects**, from the same `drill()` — one function, two readers, re-asked after every landing. Group inside an unopened group, the child once it is open, nothing on the selected panel, nothing on an inspector. New `focus.css` (`.panel-hover`, a lighter 2px inset ring). The repeating-run **`+` rides the same class** and inherits the group gate for free.

**Left, deliberately:** `ext/layout`'s `refresh()` still has no ownership test (announcing every landing compensates; the cure is in that module). The `.panel.focus` ring rule still lives in `panel.css` — it belongs beside its hover twin in `focus.css` and should move once the flow-sizing fence opens. `workspace.js`'s `focus(item, $panel)` still passes a second argument nothing reads.
